messages:
deploybot: PROD deploy started for tag `r3.6.0-hotfix-7c9e2` on cluster prod-us-west. Commit `7c9e2f4`. Canary 5% for 10m. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Rolling to service group: inference-online. Manifest: https://ci.internal/artifacts/7c9e2f4 :rocket:

jen: Ack. I'll watch logs and quick smoke test. Any model/runtime pins?

omar: We pinned runtime to `runtime/v3.4.2-quant`. Model variant is `gpt-small-q` (no schema changes).

mark: What's our rollback decision tree here? If latency regresses, do we revert commit or switch to standby model variant?

sre-oncall: Telemetry will monitor: latency_p95, error_rate, token_throughput. I'll set alerts: p95 > 800ms or errors > 1% => hold and rollback. Enabling sampling + traces for new endpoints.

releasebot: Release notes published: https://internal.releases/r3.6.0-hotfix-7c9e2 - highlights: KV cache double-evict fix, batching cap tweak. Changelog excerpt: - fix(kv-cache): avoid double-evict
- perf(batch): increase default batch cap

jen: Adding a smoke (one-liner): `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .status`

deploybot: Canary reached 5% -> no anomalies in initial 6m. Preparing 25% traffic in 2m. Pin applied: `deploy-pin:prod-us-west:7c9e2`.

omar: Ran a local replay against canary nodes to validate KV cache hit rates. Hits look normal, no regressions.

mark: If we see a sustained spike, cut traffic and pin back to `r3.6.0-7b8a1` immediately. Keep me posted.

deploybot: TRAFFIC SHIFT -> 25% complete. Canary window extended +10m due to minor GC spikes (non-user impacting).

sre-oncall: Observed GC spike at 00:28:14 UTC; p99 briefly to 1.1s but no errors. Alert thresholds not breached. Monitoring tail latencies closely.

deploybot: FULL rollout started -> shifting remaining 75% over next 6m. Finalizing tag: `r3.6.0-hotfix-7c9e2` pinned across prod-us-west. Deploy command: ```./deploy --env prod --tag r3.6.0-hotfix-7c9e2 --strategy rolling --batch 3```

jen: :thumbsup: Running smoke loop and light integration tests now.

mark: Make sure rollback steps are in the runbook link. If we need to cut traffic, use the quick rollback script.

releasebot: Runbook link: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/prod-deploys#rollback - steps 1..4 (traffic cut -> pin previous -> redeploy).

deploybot: PROD deploy complete. All shards reporting green. Final metrics: p50=110ms, p95=420ms, errors=0.08%. Deployed by CI pipeline #4821. Commit `7c9e2f4`. Tag `r3.6.0-hotfix-7c9e2`. :white_check_mark:

omar: Nice. I'll kick off extended perf job for 24h to validate tail behavior.

sre-oncall: Leaving elevated telemetry retention and additional trace sampling for 24h; will relax if stable in 2h.

jen: I'll add a short customer-facing blurb to the release notes if nothing changes overnight.

mark: Thanks team — call out if any post-deploy alerts pop.
